title: Statement of holding (CDSL DP)
when: BOD and several times a day
purpose: Every client's demat balance per ISIN: free, pledged, earmarked, lock-in; the source for collateral and sell checks.
linked: Loaded as client demat holdings and pledges (matched to clients by demat account)
source: CDSL UDiFF Catalogue V3.0.1.4, sheet Field Master, information type Statement_Of_Holding (44 fields; names, types and standard values); header and values checked against CDSL's sample file SOH_EXP_041400_123_F_202512300000_999_C_0_0_P1.csv (5 rows)

columns.name: BrnchId
columns.note: Branch Code; CHAR(6); Always 000000 for CDSL

columns.name: MktTpAndId
columns.note: Market Type; CHAR(3); Populated only for Clearing Member Statements. Refer Standard Value List; 140 standard values (catalogue, Standard Value List)

columns.name: SctiesSttlmTxId

columns.name: RcrdTp
columns.note: Record Type; CHAR(2); S - Summary B - breakup

columns.name: CurBal
columns.note: Current Balance(Total Balance)/ Current Balance for settlement pocket; DECIMAL(15,3)

columns.name: BnfcryAcctPos

columns.name: DmtrlstnPdgVrfctnBal
columns.note: Demat Pending Verification Balance /Beneficiary Demat/ Conversion of Units represented by Statement of Account; DECIMAL(15,3)

columns.name: BrrwdBal
columns.note: Borrowed Balance (Pledgee Balance – in pledgee BO A/C); DECIMAL(15,3)

columns.name: ISINFrzForDbtOrCdtBoth
